description: Historical OHLCV candles for ONE Polymarket outcome token, from the recorded L2 tape. `token_id` is the ERC-1155 outcome token id — a market's condition_id will NOT work here; read the token ids off `clob_token_ids` from polymarket_market_detail. Prices are probabilities in [0, 1]. Returns bars OLDEST first as {ts (epoch ms, UTC), open, high, low, close, volume, trades}. There is no cursor, so a window wider than `limit` is truncated at the OLD end — raise `from` to reach the recent end. With `to` and no `from`, `limit` keeps the bars nearest `to` (`to`=X, `limit`=1 is the last bar at or before X).

from.description: Epoch MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: Epoch MILLISECONDS, INCLUSIVE upper bound. Omit for no upper bound.

name: polymarket_ohlcv
title: Polymarket OHLCV
